newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sakakibara says Japan economy recovering gradually.
newsitem.headline: Sakakibara says Japan economy recovering gradually.

text.p: Eisuke Sakakibara, director-general of the Japanese Finance Ministry's International Finance Bureau, said on Thursday that the Japanese economy is recovering gradually.
Asked about his view on the economy, he said: "It is recovering gradually."
He also said that consumption has picked up along with capital investment. But he added that the recovery still lacks momentum.
He said the recent weakness of the yen has been a helpful factor in the recovery.
"The Bank of Japan Governor (Yasuo) Matsushita assessment of the economy seems to be very accurate." The BOJ chief has said for some time that the economy was recovering gradually.
Sakakibara was appearing on a TV Tokyo interview.
